verse.verse_1: We sent it [Quran] down on the Night of Destiny.
verse.verse_2: And what will make you comprehend what the Night of Destiny is?
verse.verse_3: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months;
verse.verse_4: on that night, the angels and the Spirit come down by the permission of their Lord with His decrees for all matters;
verse.verse_5: it is all peace till the break of dawn.
